event_text: CrossWind Technologies notifies the state of a potential security incident in Valcour
notes: 'Late on Monday, November 16' per the state.

event_text: The state helps take Valcour offline and cuts off connected state systems
notes: Outlets differ on whether it was Monday night or Tuesday.

event_text: Public Safety and Digital Services publish their first joint statement
notes: Posting time on the state police news page.

event_text: State says Valcour won't be back that day; 911 still unaffected
notes: Posting time on the state police news page.

event_text: The governor says the FBI is involved
notes: Per VTDigger, at a Thursday press conference.

event_text: State says it notified the Attorney General and FBI and has no restore timeline
notes: Posting time on the state police news page.

event_text: The FBI's Albany office says it is fully engaged and assisting Vermont; Valcour is still offline
The Public Safety commissioner says Valcour has no restore timeline and the state is evaluating other dispatch systems
notes: Posting time on the state police news page.
